_notes.source: All 15 codes are exactly the `code` enum of collections.purposeCodes.validator.$jsonSchema in Consolidated_Banking_DataModel_BIAN_v34_Aug17.json (v4_34), in spec order. Sourced from the spec's enum array, never hand-rolled - defect 2026-04-28, where three Literals drifted because they were written from memory. If the enum changes, regenerate; do not edit a code by hand.
_notes.scope: Doc 17 B3. The collection is declared in the canonical spec but absent from this repo - no seed file, no code reference - so the reference-data port had no data source. `SUPP` is the code in Doina's own wire_domestic sample (categoryPurpose: "SUPP") and in her stage-3 demo script.
_notes.embedding: Deliberately omitted, along with `examples` and `embeddingText`. All three exist in the spec to support semantic purpose-code matching over Atlas Vector Search, which doc 17 §6 defers: it needs an embedding model inside the synchronous payment path and 1024-dim vectors this repo does not have. Stage 3 resolves by exact code match. Adding embeddings later is additive - a new field on these rows and one method on the port.
_notes.descriptions: ISO 20022 ExternalPurpose1Code definitions, paraphrased. `category` is marked demo-specific in the spec and is used only for grouping in the UI.

records.name: Salary Payment
records.description: Payment of salaries or wages to an employee.

records.name: Pension Payment
records.description: Payment of pension benefits to a beneficiary.

records.name: Tax Payment
records.description: Payment of taxes to a government or tax authority.

records.name: Supplier Payment
records.description: Payment to a supplier against an invoice for goods or services.

records.name: Purchase of Goods
records.description: Payment for the purchase of physical goods.

records.name: Purchase of Services
records.description: Payment for the purchase of services.

records.name: Intra-Company Payment
records.description: Transfer between two entities belonging to the same group.

records.name: Treasury Payment
records.description: Treasury operation, such as a liquidity or cash-management transfer.

records.name: Dividend Payment
records.description: Payment of a dividend to a shareholder.

records.name: Commission Payment
records.description: Payment of a commission or brokerage fee.

records.name: Loan Disbursement or Repayment
records.description: Drawdown of, or repayment against, a loan facility.

records.name: Trade Settlement Payment
records.description: Settlement of a trade-finance or commercial-trade transaction.

records.name: Hedging Payment
records.description: Payment relating to a hedging or derivative contract.

records.name: Government Payment
records.description: Payment to or from a government department or agency.
